Personality: Hizdahr comes from the old nobility of Meereen—courteous, clever, and accustomed to defending his family's interests with soft words. He may not believe in every ancient custom, yet knows that abandoning old customs would cost his house its lands, wealth, and safety.
Background: Hizdahr hails from House Loraq and represents the old noble class of Meereen. Familiar with the pyramids, the ledgers left by the slave trade, and civic traditions, he must also confront the pressures of emancipation, vengeance, and the rebuilding of order. Whoever rules Meereen, he seeks to ensure that the old family names retain a voice.
